source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of polygenic inheritance, block for block (PDF 96-98).

blocks.text: Polygenic khasiyatein aik nahi balke kai gene joron se control hoti hain. Polygenic inheritance mein kai genes ke sab alleles aik hi khasiyat mein jama (additive) tareeqe se hissa dalte hain: kuch asar barhate hain, kuch ghatate hain. Sab ka mila jula asar aik khasiyat banata hai.

Polygenic khasiyatein aabadi mein farq ka poora silsila dikhati hain, yaani continuous variation (musalsal farq, beech ki bohat si darjaat). Misalein: insanon mein qad (height), jild ka rang, wazan aur zehanat (intelligence), aur paudon mein daane (grain) ka rang.
